title.pending: One permission is needed to start

permissions.intro: The following permission is what lets the app read the piano roll.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Needed to read where the notes are.
steps: Press 'Open System Settings' to open the Accessibility pane.
Find {{app}} in the list and turn its switch on.
Come back to this window and press Get started.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language the app is shown in.

debug.label: Enable debug mode
debug.description: Shows information on screen that can help with debugging.

preset.label: Preset
preset.deleteConfirm: '{{name}}' will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
preset.saveAsDescription: Keeps the effect settings in use right now under a name.
preset.name: Preset name
preset.overwriteWarning: A preset by that name already exists. It will be overwritten.

source.label: Source
source.description: Whether the effect is drawn with a color or an imported image.

file.label: Image
file.description: The picture drawn in place of the built-in shape.

blend.label: Blending
blend.description: How the picture is mixed with what shows behind it.

glow.title: Highlight
glow.description: The light that bursts as a note starts and holds while it sounds.

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: The form the light spreads in.

level.label: Brightness
level.description: The brightness held while a note sounds.

flash.label: Flash length
flash.description: How long the flash at a note's onset takes to fade.

size.label: Size
size.description: The light's radius as a multiple of the note's height.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.description: How hard the light trembles while a note sounds. 0 holds it steady.

color.label: Color
color.description: The color the light is painted in.

particles.title: Particles
particles.description: The sparks thrown off as the playhead crosses a note.

direction.label: Spread direction
direction.description: The way the particles spread out.

angle.label: Angle
angle.description: 0° is straight up, and it turns clockwise.

rate.label: Amount
rate.description: How many are emitted per second while a note sounds.

life.label: Lifetime
life.description: How long one particle takes to disappear.

spreadX.label: Sideways spread
spreadX.description: How wide the particles spread at right angles to their travel.

radiusX.label: Horizontal radius
radiusX.description: The radius the particles spread to left and right.

spreadY.label: Travel distance
spreadY.description: How far the particles travel along their direction.

radiusY.label: Vertical radius
radiusY.description: The radius the particles spread to top and bottom.

originX.label: Origin width
originX.description: The width of the band the particles are born along.

size.label: Size
size.description: How big one particle is drawn, as a multiple of its normal size.

spin.label: Rotation
spin.description: How far one particle turns before it disappears. Which way round differs per particle.

color.label: Color
color.description: The color the particles are painted in.

trail.title: Trail
trail.description: The glowing line the voice leaves behind it, tracing the pitch actually sung and fading away as it goes.

life.label: Duration
life.description: How long the line takes to fade out completely.

width.label: Thickness
width.description: The thickness of the line's bright core.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.description: How far the halo spreads past the core, as a multiple of the thickness.

sparkle.label: Sparkles
sparkle.description: How many glowing specks are left along the line. 0 leaves the line alone.

color.label: Color
color.description: The color the line and its specks are painted in.

pitch.title: Follow the pitch
pitch.description: The glow and the sparks ride the pitch that is actually sung instead of sitting at the note's centre. The trail follows the pitch whatever this is set to.

mode.label: Drives
mode.description: What the sung pitch is allowed to move.

range.label: Range
range.description: How far an effect may travel from its note.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How much the glow and sparks swell where the pitch moves. Zero holds them level.
